requirements.requirement_text: Users shall be able to add a new Todo item to a specified List; input consisting only of whitespace shall not create an item
Users shall be able to mark or unmark a Todo item as completed
Users shall be able to edit the text of a Todo item by double-clicking; saving an empty title shall delete the item
Users shall be able to delete a single Todo item
Users shall be able to toggle all Todo items to completed or active using a single control
Users shall be able to filter Todo items by All Active or Completed status
Users shall be able to clear all completed Todo items at once
